[printing] Use fixed flat map for IPP localization

Previously, `CapabilityLocalizationMap()` constructed a runtime
`base::NoDestructor<std::map<std::string_view, int>>` in generated
`ipp_l10n.cc` to map IPP capability names to localized string IDs. Since
all keys and string IDs are known at build time, replace the
heap-allocated `std::map` with a compile-time `base::fixed_flat_map`:

- Update `printing/backend/tools/code_generator.py` to generate
  `ipp_l10n.h` containing `inline constexpr auto
  kCapabilityLocalizationMap` backed by
  `base::MakeFixedFlatMap<std::string_view, int>` with pre-sorted
  entries.
- Update `chrome/common/printing/BUILD.gn` to generate
  `$target_gen_dir/ipp_l10n.h` instead of `ipp_l10n.cc` and remove the
  checked-in `chrome/common/printing/ipp_l10n.h`.
- Update `chrome/common/printing/printer_capabilities.cc` to look up
  capability localizations directly in `kCapabilityLocalizationMap`.

[DCSI] Ensure GL context is current via TLS in EGLImageBacking

EGLImageBacking::UploadFromMemory() and ReadbackToMemory() require a GL
context to be current on the calling thread for fence synchronization
and creating/accessing EGLImage sibling textures. When
CompoundImageBacking copies between an EGLImageBacking and a non-GL
backing (such as Vulkan, Dawn, or shared memory) on a thread where no GL
context is currently active, these operations would fail.

Check if a GLContext is current at the start of UploadFromMemory() and
ReadbackToMemory(), and if not, make the current thread's
SharedContextState GL context current via
SharedContextState::GetForCurrentThread().

[Churned-Users][Clank] Make button click properties read only

This CL addresses reviewer feedback
(https://chromium-review.git.corp.google.com/c/chromium/src/+/8461028/comment/85c9e7ec_d72019a8/)
by changing ON_ACCEPT_CLICKED and ON_CANCEL_CLICKED in
AutofillPaymentsChurnedUsersBottomSheetProperties from
WritableObjectPropertyKey to ReadableObjectPropertyKey.

To support read-only click handler properties at build time, the
PropertyModel creation is moved into
AutofillPaymentsChurnedUsersBottomSheetMediator, where the accept/cancel
click handlers (this::onAcceptClicked and this::onCancelClicked) are
directly available.

Key changes:
- Properties: Changes ON_ACCEPT_CLICKED and ON_CANCEL_CLICKED to
  ReadableObjectPropertyKey.
- Mediator: Creates and owns the PropertyModel. Moves getHeaderIconResId,
  getTitleResId, and getDescriptionResId from Coordinator to Mediator.
  Exposes getModel().
- Coordinator: Passes context and treatment arm to Mediator and uses
  mMediator.getModel() for the PropertyModelChangeProcessor.
- Tests: Updates AutofillPaymentsChurnedUsersBottomSheetMediatorTest
  to pass context and treatment arm to the Mediator constructor, and
  adds tests verifying model properties for security and convenience
  treatment arms.

[ResourceBroker] Add browser-side host controller

Add ResourceBrokerHost, a UI-thread singleton that manages the lifetime
of the Resource Broker utility process:
- Launches the service the first time GetService() is called, unless
  kResourceBroker is disabled.
- Passes the same session nonce to the broker on every launch.
- Waits 10 seconds after a disconnect before relaunching, and turns
  the service off for the session after 3 crashes in 10 minutes.
- Logs launch and crash-loop shutoff to ResourceBroker.LifecycleEvent.

For now, every disconnect outside shutdown counts as a crash. Telling
clean exits apart from crashes is tracked in crbug.com/560232768.

On the service side, add Initialize(BrokerConfig), which CHECKs for a
single call with a valid nonce, and register the service only when
kResourceBroker is enabled.

Clamp Omnibox Everywhere bounds to display work area on any bounds change

Previously, OmniboxEverywhereUIManager only adjusted the widget's bounds
to fit within the display work area at the end of a user drag
(OnWidgetUserDragEnded). If the widget grew while positioned near a
screen edge (for example, when typing opens the suggestions dropdown via
ResizeDueToAutoResize)), part of the widget could extend outside the
screen's work area.

This change:
- Extracts work-area clamping into AdjustBoundsToWorkArea() and
  AdjustWidgetBoundsToWorkArea().
- Clamps the target bounds directly in ResizeDueToAutoResize() before
  calling SetBounds() and defers auto-resizes while minimized.
- Implements OnWidgetBoundsChanged() to clamp non-drag bounds changes to
  the display work area, guarded by an is_adjusting_bounds_ re-entrancy
  flag.

[webauthn] Wire CryptAuth CMTG getOrCreate API

Wire CryptauthCmtgDeviceKeyProvider to the CryptAuth CMTG wrapper key
service for MakeCredential. The provider fetches an OAuth2 token for the
primary account and POSTs to /v1/users/me/cmtgWrapperKeys:getOrCreate.

For now, the service only works with JSON so that's what we're using. In
the future the service will support passing and receiving raw protos,
which will let us simplify the client.

GetAssertion keeps using the mock key until it is wired to batchGet in
a follow-up.

gpu: Restore GL context/surface after WrappedSkImageBacking MakeCurrent

WrappedSkImageBacking makes its shared context current during
initialization and destruction. Restore whichever GL context was
previously current once that work is done, so callers' context state is
preserved.

Also make the passthrough decoder verify after each command that its own
context is still current. If a command left a different context current,
the decoder now marks its context as lost instead of continuing.

[FRE] Remove legacy setFinishOnTouchOutside(true) in FirstRunActivity

FirstRunActivity is a full-screen activity (using a simulated dialog
layout on large screens via DialogWhenLargeContentLayout), not a
floating dialog window. Calling setFinishOnTouchOutside(true) is a
legacy leftover from when FirstRunActivity used @style/DialogWhenLarge
and was shared with Custom Tabs before LightweightFirstRunActivity was
split out.

On Android Automotive, the activity window is letterboxed below the OEM
caption bar (AutoCaptionControllerBar). When the user taps the caption
bar's maximize/restore button, the touch event is also dispatched to
FirstRunActivity with a negative Y coordinate (outside its DecorView
bounds). With mCloseOnTouchOutside enabled, this races with the resize
recreation and intermittently finishes FirstRunActivity, closing Chrome.

Removing setFinishOnTouchOutside(true) prevents outside touches on the
system caption bar from finishing FirstRunActivity.

[MaliciousApkDownloadCheck] Download progress message UI not working
during activity change

There are two bugs in DownloadMessageUiControllerImpl that occur
during activity transitions or when no MessageDispatcher is available:

1. In the case where the previously tracked activity was destroyed or
   the new activity needed to display the same message,
   createMessageForState() would return early without attempting to
   switch to a newly focused activity.

2. createMessageForState() has logic to prevent duplicate messages
   from showing by storing the previously shown message in
   mCurrentInfo. In the case, where MessageDispatcher is null and the
   message is not shown, mCurrentInfo still stores the message which
   gives the impression that the message was shown when it was not.

This CL fixes these bugs by:
1. Calling maybeSwitchToFocusedActivity() at the beginning of
   createMessageForState() and resetting mCurrentInfo when switching
   activities.

2. Resetting mCurrentInfo and cancelling the result timer
   if MessageDispatcher is not available.

[Omnibox] Remove expired omnibox-mia-zps flag

Per //docs/flag_expiry.md the omnibox-mia-zps flag expired in M148 and
has been removed from the chrome://flags UI. This CL removes its
flag-metadata.json entry along with the code that implemented it.

omnibox_feature_configs::MiaZPS was FEATURE_ENABLED_BY_DEFAULT, so every
call site collapses to its enabled branch:

-> AutocompleteController::UpdateResult(): "mia_enabled" now depends only
   on AimEligibilityService::IsAimAllowedByPolicy().
-> LocalHistoryZeroSuggestProvider::DeleteMatch() always normalizes the
   match contents before deletion, and QueryURLDatabase() always uses the
   non-normalized `term` for the suggestion (the
   LocalHistoryNonNormalizedContents param defaulted to true).
-> Android/IOSNTPZpsSection::InitFromMatches() always suppress pSuggest
   backfill when MIA suggestions are present. The
   SuppressPsuggestBackfillWithMIA param defaulted to
   enable_if(IS_ANDROID || IS_IOS), and these two sections are only ever
   instantiated under the corresponding platform branches in
   AutocompleteResult::GroupAndDedupMatches(), so the param was
   effectively always true wherever this code runs. The suppression is
   therefore unconditional rather than guarded on a build flag.

Because of that, the "local history zps takes precedence over Trends"
cases in AndroidNTPZpsSectionWithMIA and IosNTPZpsSectionWithMIA have
been dropped: they only covered the never-taken no-suppression path.
The remaining cases now run on every platform instead of only on
Android/iOS, so desktop bots gain coverage of the real behavior.

Also drops the now-unused omnibox_feature_configs.h import from
//ios/chrome/browser/flags/about_flags.mm and adds the explicit
build/build_config.h include that autocomplete_grouper_sections.cc was
picking up transitively for BUILDFLAG(IS_ANDROID).

[blink] Propagate color's animated source with independent inheritance

Propagate color's animated source independently so starting or stopping
a color animation does not force a full style recalc of descendants.
Color is already independent, but its animated source was grouped with
non-independent inherited sources.

Split out IndependentInheritedAnimatedSources so color's source follows
the same comparison and propagation rules as color. Store the new
subgroup alongside color under StyleInheritedData to avoid cloning
StyleMiscInheritedData on the fast path. MatchedPropertiesCache still
compares both inherited source fields to avoid reusing styles with
different animated sources.

[iOS] Fix crash for enterprise image scan

Image content string size that is between 50MB and 100MB will crash
because clipboard_analysis_request is not expecting image file that is
larger than 50MB and the request will eventually fall into NOTREACH in
CloudBinaryUploadServiceBase::CreateUploadRequest. On desktop, image
larger than 50MB is not sent for scanning and is allowed directly.
Updating IOS implementation to match the behavior of desktop.

Move crosier self-tests out of chrome/test/BUILD.gn

Move the crosier framework's own tests out of
//chrome/test:chromeos_integration_tests into per-directory targets,
using the crosier_tests() template:
- //chrome/test/base/chromeos/crosier:integration_tests:
  ash_integration_test_test.cc (with its yaml metadata),
  demo_integration_test.cc, upstart_test.cc and, for branded builds,
  test_accounts_test.cc
- //chrome/test/base/chromeos/crosier/helper:integration_tests:
  test_sudo_helper_client_test.cc

The crosier_metadata copy rule is replaced by the template's
sources_metadata, which copies the yaml file to the same place. Also
remove the leaf deps that only these tests needed from chrome/test.
chromeos_integration_tests now has no test sources of its own in
chrome/test/BUILD.gn; only chromeos_tests_main.cc stays.

This is part of an effort to shrink chrome/test/BUILD.gn by moving test
sources into per-directory targets.

- gn check passes on Linux (debug and release), ChromeOS, ChromeOS
  device (betty), Windows (x64 and x86), Mac and Android.
- gn desc runtime_deps for chromeos_integration_tests is identical
  before and after on betty, including
  crosier_metadata/ash_integration_test_test.yaml.
- chromeos_integration_tests links on betty.
- The binary can't run on a Linux host, so I compared the TestBody
  symbols in the betty binary instead: 53 -> 53, identical names.

parent
c1e8e54645818692fa0800205e744d8188232a74 [ diff ] 
Avoid synchronous PipelineController destruction in WMPI::Shutdown()

WebMediaPlayerImpl::OnPipelineSuspended() reports memory usage to V8 via
external_memory_accounter_.Update(), which can synchronously trigger a
V8 GC. If the HTMLMediaElement is unreachable, its pre-finalizer runs
ClearMediaPlayer() -> WebMediaPlayerImpl::Shutdown(). Resetting
pipeline_controller_ inside Shutdown() destroys PipelineController while
PipelineController::OnPipelineStatus() is still on the call stack,
causing a use-after-free when OnPipelineStatus() subsequently calls
Dispatch().

pipeline_controller_.reset() was originally added in Shutdown() (in
1be6d5215b1d) because PipelineImpl::RendererWrapper::DestroyRenderer()
did not reset default_renderer_. If the pipeline was stopped before
renderer initialization, default_renderer_ stayed alive until
~RendererWrapper() (triggered by ~PipelineImpl()), outliving
DestructionHelper.

Fix this by resetting default_renderer_ in
RendererWrapper::DestroyRenderer() (and when discarding a mismatched
default_renderer_ in CreateRendererInternal()), and removing
pipeline_controller_.reset() from WebMediaPlayerImpl::Shutdown() so
pipeline_controller_ is destroyed with ~WebMediaPlayerImpl().

[MaliciousApkDownloadCheck] Queue dialogs when WindowAndroid is null

Users can download an APK then close Chrome before the warning dialog is
shown resulting in GetCurrentWindow() and GetWindowHelper() returning a
null WindowAndroid when the download is re-created or updated. This CL
allows a null WindowAndroid to be forwarded to
DangerousDownloadDialogBridge.showDialog() so the dialog is queued in
mPendingDialogs and displayed once a focused ChromeTabbedActivity or
DownloadActivity becomes available.

Revert "[AIM] Trigger AIM eligibility fetch on application locale change"

This reverts commit cbdfce39080ca568c026d5479914a063a15d3d1e.

Reason for revert: ApplicationLocaleStorage::Set is only called once
during startup, before RegisterOnLocaleChangedCallback, this path never
worked on Android. The process is already killed on Android locale
change, and the startup eligibility fetch makes this change unnecessary.

Note the change in PS#1->PS#2, this is not quite a clean revert. The
obsolete metrics variant is left behind.

Original change's description:
> [AIM] Trigger AIM eligibility fetch on application locale change
>
> Observes ApplicationLocaleStorage in ChromeAimEligibilityService so
> that changes to the application language at runtime trigger a server
> eligibility request with the new locale, ensuring tools and models
> are correctly retrieved in the active language.
>
> TAG=agy
> CONV=c1ae5f2e-a6a2-40ce-a14a-271222b67b51
>

parent
b418a9ffac5991a2c053b45596a2abcebac4e877 [ diff ] 
[ios] Decode tab snapshot images in the background

Tab snapshot images were being decoded on the main thread, causing
unnecessaary latency when committing CoreAnimation transactions that
attach UIImage objects to the scene graph.

This change adds an experimental feature flag
SnapshotBackgroundDecode that causes images to be decoded in the same
background task that is responsible for fetching the image resource.

Expected effects:
* Reduces the tab grid's initial display latency, as well as the
  number of dropped frames during the transition
* Reduces tab grid scroll jank
* Reduces the latency for displaying the snapshot of the initial tab
  during startup
* Reduces startup first navigation latency
* Reduces overall hang times and hang counts.
* Reduces tab switching latency

Honor spellcheck attribute on nested elements in hot mode spell check

In HotModeSpellCheckRequester::CheckSpellingAt, the condition for
skipping spell checking previously checked:
`!root_editable->IsSpellCheckingEnabled() &&
!SpellChecker::IsSpellCheckingEnabledAt(position)`

Checking `root_editable->IsSpellCheckingEnabled()` forced the root
editable's state to be checked, which prevented nested elements from
overriding it (for example, <span spellcheck="false"> inside a
spellchecked root, or <span spellcheck="true"> inside a non-spellchecked
root).

Because `SpellChecker::IsSpellCheckingEnabledAt(position)` already walks
the ancestor chain from `position` up to `root_editable` to determine
enablement at the closest ancestor, checking only
`!SpellChecker::IsSpellCheckingEnabledAt(position)` correctly honors
nested spellcheck attributes in both directions.

Add unit tests covering both nested spellcheck="false" and
spellcheck="true".

[media] Remove kRustMpegAudioDataParser and the legacy MPEG audio parser

The Rust MP3/ADTS parser shipped behind kRustMpegAudioDataParser,
enabled by default, with a note to remove the flag after M152 reached
stable. Trunk is at M157 and the flag was never turned off, so the C++
parsing path it guarded has been dead code since then.

Remove the flag and fold the Rust path into
MPEGAudioStreamParserBase::Parse(). That leaves ParseLegacy(),
ParseFrame(), the Icecast and ID3v1/ID3v2 handling, the sync-safe
integer reader and FindNextValidStartCode() unused, so remove them
together with the start code mask, the GetMinHeaderSize() and
ParseFrameHeader() overrides in the ADTS and MPEG-1 parsers, and the
media log accessor only those overrides used. The Rust parser already
does its own sync search and metadata skipping, and the header helpers
other code uses (ParseHeader(), kHeaderSize) stay.

R=dalecurtis@chromium.org

[MiraclePtr] Enforce raw_ptr in templated containers for chrome_origin_trials_browsertest

This change replaces instances of raw C-style pointers (`T*`) with
`raw_ptr<T>` for elements stored inside templated containers (such as
`std::vector` and `std::array`). This aligns with the broader MiraclePtr
safety initiative to protect against use-after-free vulnerabilities.

This advances MiraclePtr's expansion to containers and preempts an
upcoming clang-plugin update that will strictly ban these un-rewritten
instances.

Bug: b:501142609
Doc: go/miracleptr-in-containers

[Read Anything] Add controller tests for the distiller refactor

read_anything_app_controller_unittest.cc had almost no coverage for
the kReadAnythingDistillerRefactor path. This adds 7 tests that mirror
existing tests for the non-refactored path, with the flag enabled. The
flag only changes how the controller requests and receives a
distillation. What it does with the result (display nodes, drawing,
read aloud) is the same on both paths and is already tested.

It also adds 3 refactor-only tests: reusing the active distiller,
ignoring a stale Readability reply after a tree change, and dropping a
pending reply after OnDestruct().

The tests use the real distiller factory. ScreenAI isn't available in
unit tests, so Screen2x falls back to its rules-based algorithm and
finishes synchronously. That avoids needing a fake factory and a fake
Screen2x distiller for tests.

Start CrossDevicePrefTracker when BrowserContext is created

Previously, CrossDevicePrefTrackerFactory did not override
ServiceIsCreatedWithBrowserContext(), so CrossDevicePrefTracker was only
created lazily when GetForProfile() was called. On Android,
CrossDeviceSettingImporter was the only caller, and after
https://crrev.com/c/8489930 stopped instantiating
CrossDeviceSettingImporter once settings import is complete,
CrossDevicePrefTracker was no longer created to observe local preference
changes.

Override ServiceIsCreatedWithBrowserContext() to return true so
CrossDevicePrefTracker is started when a BrowserContext is created
(matching iOS). Also override ServiceIsNULLWhileTesting() to return true
and expose GetDefaultFactory() so TestingProfile unit tests only
instantiate the tracker when explicitly requested.

[Sync] Disable DSE Prewarm in SyncTest

InProcessBrowserTest marks browser startup as complete for testing,
which allows DSE Prewarm to trigger background prerenders and spawn
extra renderer processes on every tab load in sync integration tests.
Disable DSE Prewarm by default in SyncTest using
ScopedPrewarmFeatureList, matching other browser test base classes.

[Extensions] Show first three permission details in install dialog

Currently, when there are multiple bullet points for the extension
permission section in the install dialog, all the bullet points get
tucked into a collapsible "Show Details" section. Any extension that has
4 or more bullet points will have the "Show Details" section show up.

Regardless of the number of bullet points, we want to display the first
three outside of the "Show Details" section. If a permission has four or
more bullet points, the fourth and subsequent points are placed inside
the collapsible "Show Details" section.

This CL also updates the text from "Show/Hide Details" to “Show all/Show
less” which has been approved by PM.

VT: Use kSrcOver for the first kPlus quad in a transparent SW pass.

During View Transitions, ::view-transition-image-pair has isolation: isolate and blends ::view-transition-old and ::view-transition-new into a freshly cleared transparent render pass using mix-blend-mode: plus-lighter (SkBlendMode::kPlus).

In SoftwareRenderer, drawing a full-viewport image with kPlus falls back to SkRasterPipelineBlitter, whereas drawing with kSrcOver uses Skia's fast legacy C++/SIMD blitters (SkARGB32_Shader_Blitter). Because blending with kPlus onto a transparent destination (0, 0, 0, 0) produces the exact same result as kSrcOver, override kPlus to kSrcOver for the first quad drawn into a freshly cleared transparent render pass (provided it does not have backdrop filters).

It also just generalizes this to all blending modes that are
equivalent to SrcOver on a transparent dst

VT: Omit transparent solid-color quads for no-op blend modes.

Each View Transition image render pass (::view-transition-old and
::view-transition-new) uses mix-blend-mode: plus-lighter (kPlus) and
contains a transparent hit-test PictureLayer behind the captured image
foreign layer. This caused an extra solid color (transparent) draw quad
being appended.

This patch extends the check that was already there for SrcOver to other
modes that don't change the destination (such as plus lighter)

This reduces VT frames from 5 render passes to 3, since viz can
optimize single quad content (but not two quad content)

Fix flake in select-4-option-optgroup-display-none.html

Set will-change: transform on :root in
select-4-option-optgroup-display-none.html and its reference file to
prevent subpixel rendering differences on the rounded corners of the
<select size=4> elements, and remove the failure expectation.

The flake was reproduced using UTR against 'Linux Tests (dbg)(1)'
(headless_shell_wpt_tests with --repeat-each=10), where 1 out of 10 runs
failed with a 1-channel-value difference on the rounded corner pixels.
After adding will-change: transform, all 20 runs with --repeat-each=20
on 'Linux Tests (dbg)(1)' passed without any failures.

[Safe Browsing] Fix Android suspicious site warning HaTS triggers

The SuspiciousSiteWarningSurvey did not launch when the user navigated
away from the warning, and its PSD could describe the page that replaced
the warned page.

- DidFinishNavigation records the outcome via
  CloseDialog(DismissalCause::NAVIGATE) when another main-frame
  navigation (including an error page) commits while the warning is
  showing, so the manual_navigation survey and metrics are recorded.
- Snapshot the warned page's referrer when the dialog is shown so
  referrer_origin reflects the warned page after manual navigation.

[Fusebox] Fix swipe-to-dismiss over the attachments carousel

In bottom-sheet mode, swiping down on the scrollable carousel didn't
close the popup. The carousel grabs any drag with even a little
sideways movement, so the popup never sees the swipe.

Now the popup takes over a drag first when it is mostly downward
(at least twice as vertical as horizontal, the same rule Chrome's
bottom sheet uses). Mostly sideways drags still scroll the carousel.

The popup also now only closes on a downward swipe. Before, a sideways
flick with a slight downward drift could close it by accident.

settings: Fix /paymentApps main menu highlight under URL nav

Problem: Navigating to /paymentApps via URL navigation highlights no
main menu row. AndroidPaymentAppsFragment has no main menu key, so the
highlight falls back to the root of its search index breadcrumb. The
payment apps index entry is registered without its target fragment, so
the index has no parent link for AndroidPaymentAppsFragment and the
breadcrumb lookup returns null.

Fix: Register the entry with AndroidPaymentAppsFragment as its target
fragment, matching how the page is opened at runtime.

This also gives /paymentApps deep links a breadcrumb trail. Search
results are unaffected; the entry was already searchable by title.

[glic] Fix same-URL and address-bar cases in leave confirmation

• Skip the leave confirmation when navigating to the current URL from
  the omnibox or bookmarks, keeping the active task running. This now
  applies on Android too.

• Close a pending leave confirmation when such a same-URL navigation
  replaces the navigation it was asking about.

• Catch pasted URLs and tab searches from the address bar on Desktop
  so they still show the leave prompt instead of bypassing it.

• Add unit and browser tests for same-URL, pasted-URL, keyword search,
  history navigations and a same-URL submit while the prompt is open.
  Run the same-URL unit tests on Android as well.

[BottomControls] Fix integer division in window percentage histograms

BottomControlsStacker computes the percentage of window height occupied
by bottom controls at maximum and minimum heights. Previously,
`(mTotalHeight / windowHeight) * 100` evaluated integer division before
multiplying by 100, which truncated non-zero fractional ratios below 1.0
down to 0%.

* Calculate percentages using floating point multiplication prior to
  division and round to nearest integer (`Math.round(100.f * height /
  windowHeight)`), capped at 100%.
* Guard against non-positive window height and negative control heights.
* Increment version suffix to 2 for both PercentageOfWindow histograms
  and mark the replaced histograms obsolete.
* Update BottomControlsStackerUnitTest expectations to assert accurate
  percentage values (19, 20, 8).

OBSOLETE_HISTOGRAMS[Android.BottomControlsStacker.PercentageOfWindowUsedByBottomControlsAtMaxHeight]=Replaced by Android.BottomControlsStacker.PercentageOfWindowUsedByBottomControlsAtMaxHeight2 due to integer division bug.
OBSOLETE_HISTOGRAMS[Android.BottomControlsStacker.PercentageOfWindowUsedByBottomControlsAtMinHeight]=Replaced by Android.BottomControlsStacker.PercentageOfWindowUsedByBottomControlsAtMinHeight2 due to integer division bug.

Reland "ChromeAndroidTask: Ignore window requests during PENDING_CREATE"

This is a reland of commit 16967f64f36c5a2aca63078ec348bcaf7e53aea3

This change must land after https://crrev.com/c/8534627 which fixes tests which failed upon first landing.

Original change's description:
> ChromeAndroidTask: Ignore window requests during PENDING_CREATE
>
> Drop the PENDING_CREATE action queue. Requests made before the Activity
> exists are logged and ignored, and getters return default values. The
> initial show state is applied when the Activity is adopted.
>
> Also drop the static maximized-bounds cache, which was only needed to
> predict bounds for pending Tasks and caused an ANR on Activity attach.
>

Track failure details in ProvisioningDomainProxyConfig

Adds a FailureReason enum and tracks specific failure information (failure reason, token fetch error, and HTTP response code) in ProvisioningDomainProxyConfig.

ProxyProvisioningDomainManager now populates these failure details upon policy invalidation and fetch failures, correctly maintaining or clearing them across state transitions. These failure details are also serialized in ProvisioningDomainProxyConfigToDict for diagnostics.

[ROSP] Add startup window restoration metrics

Records histograms and user actions for automatic multi-window
restoration on cold startup under the "Continue where you left off"
policy.

* Records the Android.MultiWindow.StartupRestorationInitiated user
  action and the Android.MultiWindow.StartupRestorationWindowCount
  linear count histogram when automatic restoration is initiated for
  additional windows.
* Records the Android.MultiWindow.StartupRestorationDuration timing
  histogram and the Android.MultiWindow.StartupRestorationCompleted user
  action once all pending windows have been restored.

Skip window bounds checks on Android SDKs without the bounds API

On Android SDKs that predate the window bounds API, requested window
bounds are ignored, so a popup created with bounds fills the display.
These tests passed only because ChromeAndroidTask returned the
requested bounds from a stale cache instead of the real window bounds.

Skip the bounds assertions when BaseWindow::CanResize() reports
anything but kOk, so the tests keep passing once the cache is removed.

parent
46fcf3faed9db394de7046a100301f64c2842f0e [ diff ] 
[Win] Ignore no-op location changes in occlusion

The native window occlusion tracker hooks EVENT_OBJECT_LOCATIONCHANGE
for each process that owns a visible, opaque top-level window, and
schedules a full occlusion calculation (an EnumWindows pass with region
math) for almost every event from those processes. Many of these events
can't change occlusion: a per-process hook also reports child windows,
and layered windows raise the event every time they update their
contents, even if they don't move. E.g., an app that repaints a child
layered window every ~31 ms keeps every Chromium browser process
recalculating occlusion at that rate, with the same result each time.

Ignore location changes that can't change the occlusion state of the
tracked root windows:
- Child windows: a child window can only move within its parent, and
  occlusion is computed from top-level windows only. These events are
  dropped in the hook callback.
- Other top-level windows: the set of occluding HWNDs used for
  EVENT_OBJECT_DESTROY becomes a map that also records the bounds each
  window had in the last calculation. A location change is ignored if
  the window still can't occlude other windows, or still can and its
  bounds are unchanged. This check runs in a task posted to the
  calculator's sequence, since the hook callback runs outside it.

Location changes of the tracked root windows still always trigger a
calculation. The filtering is behind the
kFilterNativeWinOcclusionLocationChanges feature, enabled by default, as
a kill switch.

Adds unit tests for the filtering, run with the feature enabled and
disabled. WindowOcclusionCalculator is exported so that the tests can
use it in component builds; exporting its enclosing class doesn't
export it.

With a test app that updates a child layered window, a top-level layered
window, and an opaque window with SWP_FRAMECHANGED every 31 ms, 969
location change events caused 953 occlusion calculations before this
change, and none after. Moving, covering, uncovering, and destroying
windows over Chromium still updated its visibility as before.

c6777de845023cdcf3188ed75e4673aa3af567c2 [ diff ] 
[Connection-Allowlist] Enforce WebRTC blocking in binders via no-op impls

Previously, WebRTC blocking by the Connection Allowlist was decided in
PopulateBinderMapWithContext(): when the enforced allowlist blocked
WebRTC, the MdnsResponder and P2PSocketManager binders were never
registered. This had two problems:

1. The wrong Connection Allowlist was checked. The binder map is built
   once, when the BrowserInterfaceBroker is created: in
   CreateRenderFrame() or FrameTree::AddFrame() for a new
   frame, and again in DidCommitNavigation(). The commit path
   rebuilds the broker before DidCommitNewDocument() installs the
   new document's PolicyContainerHost, so the check saw the previous
   document's policies (typically those of the initial empty document).

2. Unregistered interfaces crashed the renderer. The renderer still
   requests MdnsResponder and P2PSocketManager when it creates the peer
   connection factory, which occurs in the RTCPeerConnection constructor.
   With no binder registered, BrowserInterfaceBrokerImpl calls
   ReportNoBinderForInterface(), which reports a bad message and kills the
   renderer. This crash was mainly reproducible for nested about:blank and
   about:srcdoc frames. Because they are created after the parent navigation
   commit, they inherit the correct allowlist from their parent, which means
   they never actually bind the interfaces when WebRTC is blocked.

This CL fixes both:

- The Connection Allowlist check now runs inside the binder functions
  (BindSocketManager() and RenderFrameHostImpl::CreateMdnsResponder()).
  They run only when the renderer actually requests the interface,
  which happens from script in an already-committed document, so the
  check reads that document's policy container. Both binders are now
  always registered, so the renderer can no longer be killed for
  requesting them.

However, this fix introduces another potential issue. Which is
that any IPC sent to these now-correctly-unbound interfaces will
never fire callbacks, leaving potential for hangs in renderer-side
code.

Now, when WebRTC is blocked, the binders bind no-op implementations
instead of dropping the receiver:

- NoOpP2PSocketManager reports an empty network list, returns no
addresses from GetHostAddress(), and closes the pipes passed to
CreateSocket(). It stays connected, so the renderer's
P2PSocketDispatcher does not enter its reconnect loop.

- NoOpMdnsResponder runs every reply callback with failure values
and never registers or announces a name.

So calls from production code fail gracefully instead of hanging or
crashing, and no sockets are created and no mDNS names are registered,
whatever the renderer does.

This also removes the fenced-frame P2PSocketManager ban from the binder
map, as part of the ongoing removal of fenced frames.

Tests:
- New content_unittests: NoOpMdnsResponderTest.*,
NoOpP2PSocketManagerTest.*
- New WPTs covering nested child about:blank / about:srcdoc frames under
a parent's Connection Allowlist, verifying they do not crash and
properly respect the WebRTC parameter of the inherited allowlist.
- Existing virtual/connection-allowlist WebRTC WPTs continue to pass.

Support wildcard sampling rates in Cronet UMA allowlist

Allows "*" to be used alongside explicit histogram hashes and to specify
a default sampling rate (e.g., "*:0.01") for all non-declared
histograms. Histograms not explicitly listed will fall back to the
wildcard rate, defaulting to 0.0 when no wildcard is provided. Also adds
unit tests covering wildcard sampling rates and individual overrides.

Preserve 'none' keywords across relative color resolution

Per [1]:

> The component keywords return a <number>, or 'none'.

Factor out a ToChannelValue() helper from UnresolvedRelativeColor's
Resolve() implementation and make it handle an expression that consists
of only a component keyword reference. Pass std::optional<float> via
EvaluationInput so that any 'none' keywords are preserved. Use
Color::ConvertToColorSpaceForInterpolation() so that component keywords
are carried forward through any conversion. Drop the explicit conversion
from UnresolvedAlphaColor::Resolve() since it will be handled
downstream.

[1] https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-5/#relative-syntax

e21083beefbf66955baf440e99068515dac2ed17 [ diff ] 
[gpu] Remove Intel IvyBridge multisampling workaround on Linux

Entry 59 disables GL_CHROMIUM_framebuffer_multisample on Linux Intel
IvyBridge GPUs to work around a driver bug from 2012. Here:
- The decoder rejects BlitFramebufferCHROMIUM and
  RenderbufferStorageMultisampleCHROMIUM as unknown commands, but
  WebGL 2 still sends them for blitFramebuffer() and
  renderbufferStorageMultisample(), so those calls lose the context.
- WebGL silently drops antialiasing.
IvyBridge GPUs are still in use, and Mesa has since replaced the
i965 driver with crocus for them.

Remove entry 59. It is the last use of
disable_chromium_framebuffer_multisample, so remove that workaround
as well.

[ios] Avoid initializing defaultConfiguration singleton in unit test

CWVProfileScopedConfigurationTest.MultitonCaching previously called
+[CWVWebViewConfiguration defaultConfiguration] to assert that an
unscoped configuration has a nil storageIdentifier, and then shut it
down via +[CWVWebViewConfiguration shutDown] in teardown. Because
+defaultConfiguration uses dispatch_once, this left the global
gDefaultConfiguration singleton permanently shut down (with a null
browserState) for the remainder of the test process, causing
CWVWebViewConfigurationTest.ShutDownAllConfigurations to hit a DCHECK
when both tests ran in the same batch.

Construct a local CWVWebViewConfiguration instance instead so the global
singleton remains untouched for ShutDownAllConfigurations.

WebDriver BiDi: Report unsupported extension install

Translate a missing CDP Extensions.loadUnpacked command to the
WebDriver BiDi unsupported operation error. This prevents Android
from exposing the CDP method-not-found error when extension
installation is unavailable.

Update the Android install baselines and add unit coverage for CDP
error translation, successful path installation, and unchanged
archive/base64 behavior. Guard nullish errors and absent or non-string
messages so unexpected rejections are preserved rather than masked.

Make DataListIndicatorElement not focusable

DataListIndicatorElement (the UA shadow DOM element backing
::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator on <input list>) inherited from
HTMLDivElement without overriding SupportsFocus(), unlike other inner
text control elements. When styled with overflow: scroll, it became a
focusable scroll container and could be focused (e.g. by dialog
focusing steps). Removing it when the <datalist> lost its options
would then synchronously fire a blur event during
IdTargetObserverRegistry::NotifyObservers().

Override DataListIndicatorElement::SupportsFocus() to return
FocusableState::kNotFocusable so the internal indicator element cannot
be focused.

[ios] Add WebView pref migration and remove safe lifecycle pref

This is a follow-up to crrev.com/c/8102804, which hardened
CWVAutofillController against WebState destruction behind the
cwv.autofill.safe_lifecycle_enabled pref. The pref has been fully
rolled out in the client, so the hardening is now unconditional and
the pref is deprecated.

ios/web_view previously had no way to clean up obsolete prefs, so this
also adds MigrateObsoleteBrowserStatePrefs(), called once per
BrowserState after its PrefService is created, mirroring Chrome's
MigrateObsoleteProfilePrefs().

[Glic] Prevent focus on click when actor controls tab

On CrOS & Linux, when the user interacts with a WebContents, logic runs
to ensure that the native window that hosts that WebContents is
activated. This logic also runs when the Actor clicks on a WebContents,
causing the window to be activated without any user interaction.

In the case where the actor is actively controlling the tab, there is
limited opportunity for the user to interact with the WebContents (the
scrim overlay blocks it). Although there are some instances where use
input is _not_ blocked with an active task (i.e. short running tasks),
practically this is a strong signal the interaction was not user
generated.

This CL tweaks the logic to check if the tab is being actively
controlled by the actor, and in that case avoid activating the window.

Revert "[AIM] Trigger AIM eligibility fetch on iOS locale change"

This reverts commit 0ded20a904addce4baee1677716bd29d7641ad35.

Reason for revert: ApplicationLocaleStorage::Set is only called once
during startup on iOS, Android, and desktop, while on ChromeOS sign-in
it triggers duplicate eligibility requests.

Original change's description:
> [AIM] Trigger AIM eligibility fetch on iOS locale change
>
> Observes ApplicationLocaleStorage in IOSChromeAimEligibilityService so
> that runtime application locale changes on iOS trigger a server
> eligibility fetch with the new locale.
>
> Also updates GetLocaleImpl to retrieve the active locale from
> ApplicationLocaleStorage.

Stop the delayed intersection timer when disposing LocalFrameView

Closing a page with a pending delayed IntersectionObserver update can
leave the timer active after frame detachment. If the view is still
alive, the timer can call ScheduleAnimation() on the detached frame.

Stop the timer in LocalFrameView::Dispose() and add a regression test
that keeps the view alive after detachment and verifies cancellation.

[gpu] Remove legacy Adreno 2xx/3xx and BayTrail workaround entries

Remove GPU driver bug list entries that can no longer match the
devices they target:
- Entries 214, 359 and software rendering list entry 140 only apply
  to Adreno 3xx GPUs before Android 9, but Chrome requires Android
  10. Entry 214 is the only user of
  force_update_scissor_state_when_binding_fbo0, so also remove that
  workaround and its code in GLES2DecoderImpl.
- Entry 19 targets Adreno 2xx GPUs, which never shipped with Android
  10. Its original problem is unknown, and its renderer pattern also
  matches newer GPUs such as the Adreno A22 (renderer string
  "Adreno (TM) 22"), where it needlessly disables WEBGL_depth_texture.
  With entries 19 and 359 gone, also remove the disable_depth_texture
  workaround.
- Entry 97 only matches Intel's proprietary BayTrail driver, which
  shipped with Android 4.4 and 5.x and is way below Android's min
  version of 10.

Note: Will remove disable_chromium_framebuffer_multisample as it
corresponds to another entry which is also probably not needed.

[Voice Search] Show AI Mode arrow after stopping realbox voice search

After the stop button is clicked, the NTP realbox gets the voice search
transcript through NtpSearchboxElement.setInputText(). Text set
programmatically does not fire `searchbox-input-text-updated`, so
`hasUserInput_` stayed false and the dynamic AI Mode button kept its
sparkle icon until the user typed again.

Update `hasUserInput_` in setInputText(), like OmniboxElement already
does, so the button switches to the arrow as soon as the transcript is
placed in the input.

https://screencast.googleplex.com/cast/NTg2ODI1MzQ5MzU5MjA2NHxkMWE4NzM3Yi1lZA

[TabData] Remove TabChangeType::kBlockedOnly

TabStripModelObserver::OnTabChangedAt() was historically used for
clients to be notified when the TabRendererData was updated. The
TabRendererData was deprecated in favor of clients directly
subscribing for the specific data. This CL removes the kBlockedOnly
tab change type which reduces the number of callsites to
NotifyTabChanged() and make clients explicitly subscribe to tab
block status changes.

ash: Migrate arc::ResizeToggleMenu button colors to ui::ColorId

This CL simplifies `ResizeToggleMenu::MenuButtonView` by setting its
`ui::ColorId`-based colors at construction and on selection changes
only. Previously, this view was required to manually handle theme
updates by overriding `OnThemeChanged()`, and its constructor
installed a `gfx::kPlaceholderColor` background until the first theme
change.

Following crrev.com/c/6236788, crrev.com/c/6267139 and
crrev.com/c/6313744, `UpdateColors()` passes `ui::ColorId`s directly to
`ui::ImageModel::FromVectorIcon()`, `views::Label::SetEnabledColor()`
and `views::CreateRoundedRectBackground()`. The icon, label and
background now automatically handle theme changes, eliminating the
need for manual color management.

[histogram-cleanup] Remove expired Renderer.Unresponsive.Visibility

This removes the Renderer.Unresponsive.Visibility histogram, which
expired on 2024-11-30 and was never extended, so nothing is collecting
or reading it anymore. The only recording site was the boolean record
at the top of the unresponsive-renderer metrics helper in
WebContentsImpl, so I dropped that call along with the histogram's
entry in the renderer histograms.xml. The other Renderer.Unresponsive.*
metrics recorded by that helper are not expired and are left alone.

This change was generated using the skill histogram-cleanup.

[chromium-bidi] Return no such frame for empty context locator

browsingContext.locateNodes rejected an empty context ID as an invalid selector before consulting browsing-context storage. Empty text is a valid context-ID shape and, like any other unknown ID, must produce no such frame.

Route all context IDs through the normal lookup, add mapper E2E coverage for empty and non-existing IDs, and remove the now-obsolete WPT failure baseline.

Remove void element end tags from HTML embedded and forms WPTs

base, img, input, embed, source, param and frame have no end tag.
Writing their end tag anyway is a parse error, and the parser drops the
tag so the source suggests a structure the document never had.

This CL removes those invalid end tags from
third_party/blink/web_tests/external/wpt/html/semantics/embedded-content
and third_party/blink/web_tests/external/wpt/html/semantics/forms.

No behavior change.

parent
a9ff225e54ac2473dbfba1518c53826f4c6aa6ab [ diff ] 
[BottomSheet] Fix wrap-content measurement and viewport bottom inset

1. In `getViewportBottomInset()`, guard against non-empty
        `mVisibleViewportRect` rather than `isSheetOpen()`. When
        opening a `WRAP_CONTENT` sheet in landscape (where
        `e2eBottomInset == 0` and navigation bar bottom inset is
        non-zero), `isSheetOpen()` was false during initial
        `showContent()` measurement, causing
        `getViewportBottomInset()` to return 0. Using
        `!mVisibleViewportRect.isEmpty()` ensures the bottom inset is
        accounted for immediately during initial wrap-content
        measurement. In `calculateSheetTranslationY()`, also zero
        `bottomInsetAdjustment` when `currentOffsetPx <= 0`.

2. In `updateViewportAndBottomInset()`, call
        `invalidateContentDesiredHeight()` when
        `insetOrHeightChanged` is true so container height or
        viewport inset changes seen by a layout pass trigger
        remeasurement of `WRAP_CONTENT` sheet content. In
        `onInsetChanged()`, do the same when the viewport bottom
        inset differs from the one seen by the last layout pass, and
        re-wrap an open `WRAP_CONTENT` sheet so that inset animations
        resettle it. `mPreviousViewportBottomInset` is still only
        updated by the layout pass, so the next layout pass still
        detects the change.

3. Add `getSystemBarOrEdgeToEdgeBottomInset()`, which returns
        the larger of the edge-to-edge bottom inset and the bottom
        system bars inset (or 0 for large form factor sheets and
        sheets with a bottom margin), without adding the keyboard
        height. Use it in `getContentBottomPadding()` and pass it to
        `mMediator.calculateSheetTranslationY()` in
        `setSheetOffsetFromBottom()`. In landscape mode where
        `e2eBottomInset` is 0 but navigation bar bottom inset is
        non-zero, this accounts for the bottom system bar inset. As
        with the edge-to-edge inset before, the translation also
        applies to `RESIZE_CONTENT` sheets.

4. In `ensureContentDesiredHeightIsComputed()`, subtract both
        `getHandlebarHeight()` and `getContentBottomPadding()` from
        `getMaxSheetHeight()` when measuring `WRAP_CONTENT` sheet
        content with `MeasureSpec.AT_MOST`.

Before:
https://screencast.googleplex.com/cast/NTExMzE2MDE5MjIyOTM3NnwwNTdhZDdjNi0wZg
https://screencast.googleplex.com/cast/NjE1MDI3OTc2MTc1NjE2MHxkYzQxNTFiMC0wNA
After:
https://screencast.googleplex.com/cast/NTM1MTY1MDA5NjA1NDI3Mnw0YWMxYTZiYS1hMg

[ContextualTasks] Route search messages on page

Search messaging between the browser and the AIM page previously relied
on frame-scoped `ContextualTasksExtensionHandler` instances, which
dropped outbound messages whenever no extension iframe was mounted or
before the initial handshake completed. Relocating page-level search
message handling and outbound pre-handshake queuing to
`ContextualTasksWebContentsUserData` allows search communication to
succeed even when zero extension iframes are present.

Per-page search messaging state (including the active document ID,
handshake readiness, outbound message queue, and mounted Lens/Context
Library input state) is scoped to `content::PageUserData` so cross-page
navigations automatically reset page-specific state without breaking
Back/Forward Cache restoration.

Initialize font RendererPreferences from settings in WebContentsImpl

Initialize font-related RendererPreferences in WebContentsImpl so that
all WebContents (such as WebUI) receive system font rendering settings
by default.

Add ContentBrowserClient::
ShouldUpdateFontRendererPreferencesFromSystemSettings() (overridden in
WebTestContentBrowserClient to return false) so that web tests continue
to use default font rendering preferences for deterministic results.

Also remove static from params in
UpdateFontRendererPreferencesFromSystemSettings. This type of caching
is not needed because caching is already implemented at other layers
and the static here prevents any run-time changes.

Update the Skia Gold baseline CL string in affected WebUI dialog,
bubble, and Profile Picker pixel tests so previous non-subpixel-rendered
baselines are invalidated.

[ImmersivePlayer] Fix initial hemisphere pose in 180 mode

Removes the setAnchorPose override in ImmersiveVideoPoseStrategyHemisphere
so that mCurrentYaw updates when new anchor poses arrive during the
initial head-pose stabilization window. Previously, mCurrentYaw was set
once on the first (often unstabilized or null) anchor pose and never
updated when the head pose stabilized.

Also restricts re-fetching head pose in showControlPanel() to SPHERE
mode only, so re-showing controls in HEMISPHERE mode does not overwrite
the hemisphere's yaw.

Keep Apply snackbar on recreate

Previously, showOfferApplySnackbarAfterDialogs passed a null
PendingSnackbar while showSnackbarAfterDialogs immediately marked
settings as imported in SharedPreferences. If an Android-synced NTP
background image finished downloading and triggered Activity#recreate()
while the "Apply settings?" snackbar was showing or queued behind modal
dialogs, the snackbar was dismissed and never restored in the recreated
Activity.

Store a PendingSnackbar for the Offer Apply snackbar and restore it in
maybeShowPendingSnackbar so it survives Activity#recreate().

ef6a48c4c047ad5ca7c93bda2ff3a9d90d9b281f [ diff ] 
[ios][deflake] Fix tap-after-autofill flake in SaveProfileEGTest

testUserData_LocalUpdate tapped the email field with
TapWebElementWithId right after accepting an autofill suggestion.
TapWebElementWithId computes its tap point when the action is created,
before EarlGrey idles, while the keyboard transition and focus zoom
triggered by autofill are still in flight. The tap then lands on a
neighboring field (Zip), the mousedown verification times out and
EarlGrey reports "Reason for action failure was not provided".

This CL:
- Settles the keyboard after autofill (blur and wait for the keyboard
  to disappear) so subsequent coordinate taps see a stable layout.
- Taps the email field via a helper that scrolls it into view, retries
  the tap with a freshly computed point, and verifies focus.
- Waits for all simulated key events to land before submitting.
- Submits with a JS click instead of a coordinate tap.
- Removes the iPad-only suppression. CI history shows the flake is on
  iPhone simulators (iPhone 15 18.5 ~30%, iPhone 16 27.0 ~9%), while
  iPads were not affected.

Local results (Xcode 27.0 RC), iPhone 15 / iOS 18.5:
- Before: 10/100 passed, all 90 failures at the email tap.
- After: 250/250 passed (200 with CI simulator prefs).
SaveProfileEGTest passes on iPhone 15 18.5, iPhone 16 27.0 and
iPad Pro 13-inch (M4) 18.5.

[xr][gpu] Use WaitSyncTokenAndFinish in OpenXrRenderLoop

When UseAutomaticSyncTokenManagement is enabled (in the future),
OpenXrGraphicsBinding::EndSharedImagesExport() stores the exported
SyncTokens inside each layer's ClientSharedImage and outputs empty
SyncTokens into `combined_sync_tokens`. In OpenXrRenderLoop's
SubmitFrameDrawnIntoTexture(), when `supports_gpu_fence_` is false,
waiting directly on `combined_sync_tokens` via WaitSyncTokenCHROMIUM()
becomes a no-op before calling gl->Finish().

To fix this, the current CL adds a WaitSyncTokenAndFinish() overload in
ClientSharedImage accepting vectors of ClientSharedImages and SyncTokens
and calls it in OpenXrRenderLoop::SubmitFrameDrawnIntoTexture().

[payments] Destroy PaymentRequestDialogView throbber when not in use

PaymentRequestDialogView displays a processing spinner overlay
(throbber_overlay_) with a throbber and "Processing" label while the
dialog is initializing or updating payment details. Previously,
throbber_overlay_ was created once in the constructor and kept in the
view hierarchy for the lifetime of the dialog, toggling SetVisible()
and manually setting ViewAccessibility::SetIsIgnored() and SetIsLeaf()
so screen readers would ignore the overlay while hidden.

This CL resolves TODO(crbug.com/40894873) by creating and attaching
throbber_overlay_ in ShowProcessingSpinner() (inlining
SetupSpinnerOverlay()) and removing and destroying it via
RemoveChildViewT() in HideProcessingSpinner(), matching how
loading_view_overlay_ is managed in ShowLoadingView() and
RemoveLoadingView(). Because throbber_overlay_ is no longer kept in the
view hierarchy when hidden, the manual SetIsIgnored() and SetIsLeaf()
overrides and separate throbber_ member pointer are no longer needed.

Remove RawDraw from viz

RawDraw has been disabled by default and unmaintained for years. This is
the second of several CLs removing it. SkiaRenderer no longer plays back

DisplayResourceProviderSkia, ExternalUseClient, ImageContextImpl and

BackgroundFetch: stop using Blobs during request lookup

When retrieving a request body from cache storage, don't wrap it in a
Blob. The Blob is immediately redirected into a DataPipeGetter anyway
when used by the browser for the upload/download. Registration of a
BlobDataItem/BlobDataItemReader with the BlobContext is unnecessary
complexity which uses extra mojo pipes and async steps. If the request
is retrieved by the renderer with Match, the Blob wrapper is again
unnecessary most of the time.

This change doesn't affect the lifetime of data: as with the
BlobDataItem before it, the DataPipeGetter will stop working if the
cache storage entry needs to be deleted.

"GetRequestBlob" symbol names are changed to "GetRequestBody" in many
places.

Also add WPT coverage for BgF uploads. (It seems like ReadableStream
body *should* be supported, but currently is not, so that's left out of
the test.)

fuzzilli: Ensure union related-types have unique names

The Fuzzilli Profile generator emits a few types for each union. The
generated names may conflict with other types. For instance, in
url_request.mojom there is a `DataElementsBytes` struct [1] that gets a
`jsNetworkMojomDataElementsBytesConstructor` ILType. There is also a
DataElement union with a bytes field [2]. The per-variant constructor
emitted would also be named `jsNetworkMojomDataElementBytesConstructor`.
Adding a Union suffix resolves this issue.

[1]: https://crsrc.org/c/services/network/public/mojom/url_request.mojom;l=653;drc=e184e3376a9f714b3e3e3e1e9fdff4338a4a5e98
[2]: https://crsrc.org/c/services/network/public/mojom/url_request.mojom;l=681;drc=e184e3376a9f714b3e3e3e1e9fdff4338a4a5e98

[tools/perf] Merge blink_perf trace events per thread

_ComputeTraceEventsThreadTimeForBlinkPerf previously passed all events
from model.IterAllEventsOfName(event_name) across every process and
thread into _CreateMergedEventsBoundaries at once. When two slices of
the same name on different threads overlapped in wall time,
_CreateMergedEventsBoundaries merged them into a single interval and
computed thread_or_wall_duration by subtracting the first event's
thread_start from the last event's thread_end. Because thread_start
uses each thread's independent CPU clock (CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID),
subtracting timestamps across threads produced negative or bogus CPU
durations (failing testBlinkPerfTracingMetricsForMeasureTime with
negative mean layout times).

Fix this by merging overlapping events per thread via
model.GetAllThreads() before accumulating CPU durations across threads,
and check `is not None` for thread timestamps so zero-valued thread
timestamps are preserved.

Deflake and re-enable FullScreenVideoClosed browser test on Mac

Add ui::test::ScopedFakeNSWindowFullscreen to
TabUsageScenarioTrackerBrowserTest on Mac to avoid asynchronous AppKit
Space transitions that caused the window to be reported as occluded in
the second interval. Re-enable FullScreenVideoClosed; on mac26-arm64-rel
with UTR, FullScreenVideoClosed passed 100/100 times with this change
(vs. failing 6/100 times without it), and FullScreenVideo passed 100/100
times.

FullScreenVideoCrash remains disabled on Mac (failed 1/30 times with
UTR): crashing the tab installs SadTab (hiding WebContentsViewCocoa),
and when navigating away unhides it while another parallel test window
occludes the NSWindow, WebContentsViewCocoa delays reporting kOccluded
by 1s, leaving the WebContents hidden when ResetIntervalData() runs.

Manually convert SyncServiceFactory to inherit from the template
TypedProfileKeyedServiceFactoryIOS<Factory, Service> as the

BuildSyncService() function. The change was still generated with
the script, and then the partially reverted to restore the damage
caused to the helper function.

Add a comment that GetForProfileAsSyncServiceImplForTesting() is
undefined behavior if called after setting a test factory.

[apple] Deduplicate lists by default in plist_util merge

When merging multiple plists via MergePList() in plist_util.py
(e.g., merging Info.plist with additions such as
LSApplicationQueriesSchemes.plist), list values were concatenated
without deduplicating entries. If multiple plists specified identical
elements (for instance 'googledrive' in LSApplicationQueriesSchemes or
UIDeviceFamily), the resulting plist contained duplicate entries.

This CL enables list deduplication by default in MergePList() and
adds a `--[no-]dedup-list` option to the merge action in plist_util.py.
It also exposes `dedup_list` in the tweak_info_plist template.

Add arrow key traversal interactive UI tests for input protection

This CL adds interactive UI tests to InputProtectionInteractiveUiTest to
verify that unmodified arrow keys traverse focus between views, during
input protection cooldown, as well as while occluded by an Always-On-Top
window.

Alo verify that modified arrow keys, such as Ctrl+Down and Shift+Right,
are not treated as focus traversal, and are blocked during cooldown.

[Side Panel][Vertical Tabs] Animate resize handle with container resize.

The resize handle isn't a ChangeBounds target, so it jumps to its final
position on animated resizes. Add a ChangeBounds targeting it.

[Toolbar] Add param to control toolbar lockout duration

Currently, browser controls lockout durations—such as fullscreen load
delay and minimum controls visibility—are hardcoded to 3000 ms.
Introducing Finch parameters allows experimentation with shorter lockout
durations (e.g., 1000–2000 ms) to improve UI responsiveness without
compromising spoofing protections.

* Adds the `kBrowserControlsLockoutDuration` feature flag along with
  cached integer parameters `fullscreen_load_delay_ms` and
  `minimum_show_duration_ms` (both defaulting to 3000 ms).
* Wires parameters into getLoadDelayMs() in
  TabStateBrowserControlsVisibilityDelegate and
  getMinimumShowDurationMs() in
  BrowserStateBrowserControlsVisibilityDelegate.
* Enforces defense-in-depth clamping to [1000, 3000] ms via
  MathUtils.clamp to meet security requirements.
* Adds Robolectric unit tests in
  TabStateBrowserControlsVisibilityDelegateTest and
  BrowserStateBrowserControlsVisibilityDelegateTest verifying parameter
  overrides and boundary clamping.

parent
dc4cebfd742d17c1de3feebebfac072da65d127e [ diff ] 
[PDF Ink Signatures] Maintain in-progress strokes incrementally

Previously, `PdfInkModule::DrawingStrokeState::inputs` stored raw input
batches, and PdfInkModule::CreateInProgressStrokeSegmentsFromInputs()
rebuilt all ink::InProgressStroke objects from scratch on every
PdfInkModule::Draw() and FinishStroke() call. This discarded cached
modeling state and performed O(N) stroke modeling work per frame.

Rename `inputs` to `in_progress_strokes`, store ink::InProgressStroke
objects directly, and update the active stroke incrementally as stroke
inputs arrive. Remove CreateInProgressStrokeSegmentsFromInputs(). Also
CHECK in FinishStroke() that `in_progress_strokes` is non-empty, since
StartStroke() always adds an in-progress stroke.

TAG=agy
CONV=ed02773a-408d-4e6e-9033-6259d3ae7f9e
